training_selection: same first 500 sorted train PNGs as Run 3B
validation_selection: same first 100 sorted validation PNGs as Run 3B

conditions.jpeg90: one OpenCV JPEG encode/decode at quality 90
conditions.jpeg70: one OpenCV JPEG encode/decode at quality 70
conditions.jpeg50: one OpenCV JPEG encode/decode at quality 50
conditions.reencode1: one sequential OpenCV JPEG encode/decode pass at quality 85; identical to JPEG Q85
conditions.reencode2: two sequential OpenCV JPEG encode/decode passes, each quality 85
conditions.reencode3: three sequential OpenCV JPEG encode/decode passes, each quality 85

balanced_schedule: 1000 condition labels formed by cyclic allocation then deterministically shuffled
checkpoint: lowest macro-average validation BER across seven conditions; validation BCE tie-break
